battle.name: 湘州之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年二月，隋行軍元帥楊素遣龐暉略地湘州，湘州刺史岳陽王陳叔慎詐降設伏斬龐暉，徵兵五千抗拒。隋遣湘州刺史薛胄、行軍總管劉仁恩進攻，擊敗助防將軍陳正理與樊通之軍，乘勝入城俘陳叔慎，又於常德橫橋破武州刺史邬居業。卡面希臘重步兵為古希臘方陣兵器，與本役相隔逾千年，不在戰場。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是開皇九年（589年）隋朝在長江中游對南陳的攻略作戰之一環，交戰雙方是北方的隋與偏安江南的陳。隋朝一方由文帝楊堅統籌，晉王楊廣任行臺尚書令、淮南行省總百揆，楊素為行軍元帥總領上游水陸大軍，賀若弼、韓擒虎等將領自廣陵、廬州分道渡江；湘州戰線由行軍元帥楊素調度，先遣別將龐暉略地，失利後改由新任湘州刺史薛胄與行軍總管劉仁恩率軍進攻。隋軍的編制承自北周的州郡兵與行軍總管府直屬精兵，騎兵、步卒、弩手混編，糧秣沿長江與湘水漕運供應。南陳一方以都城建康為中樞，湘州刺史、岳陽王陳叔慎以湘州（治長沙）為據點，節制衡陽郡太守樊通、武州刺史邬居業等地方官署，並就地徵召州兵；陳的州郡守軍多由鄉兵、宗族部曲與中央調來的禁軍拼成，守土無援是其結構性弱點。湘州得失，實際上決定了陳朝能否守住長江以南、嶺北與嶺南之間的水陸樞紐。
countriesEn: This battle was one link in the Sui campaign of 589, the ninth year of Kaihuang, against Southern Chen in the middle reaches of the Yangtze; the belligerents were the northern Sui and the dynasty that held the south of the river. On the Sui side the overall direction lay with Emperor Wen, Yang Jian; the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, served as Xing Tai Shangshu Ling and governor of Huainan, taking charge of the administration, while Yang Su was made Chief Military Commander to command the great armies by land and water in the upper reaches, and generals such as He Ruobi and Han Qinhu crossed the river on separate routes from Guangling and Luzhou. The Xiangzhou front was directed from the headquarters of Yang Su: an advance detachment under the separate commander Pang Hui was sent to take the prefecture, and after that failure the attack was handed to the new Inspector of Xiangzhou, Xue Zhou, and to Liu Ren'en, Commander of the Marching Army. The Sui army was built on the prefectural troops of the former Northern Zhou and the elite units directly under the commanders of the marching armies, with cavalry, infantry and crossbowmen mixed in the same order of battle, and its grain and supplies came up the Yangtze and the Xiang River by water. On the Chen side the centre of gravity was the capital at Jiankang; the Inspector of Xiangzhou and Prince of Yueyang, Chen Shushen, held Xiangzhou, seated at Changsha, as his base, with authority over the local administrations of the Governor of Hengyang, Fan Tong, and the Inspector of Wuzhou, Wu Juye, and he levied the prefectural militia on the spot. Chen's prefectural garrisons were pieced together mostly from local militia, clan contingents and detachments of palace troops sent down from the capital, so that garrisons without relief from outside were their structural weakness. Whether Xiangzhou was held or lost therefore decided in practice whether the Chen dynasty could keep the hinge between the south of the Yangtze, the northern Ling region and Lingnan.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的有六人。隋文帝楊堅是最高決策者，他在開皇八年冬調集大軍分道伐陳，志在消滅南朝、結束南北分裂。行軍元帥楊素統率長江上游水軍，沿江東下、掃清陳方江防，正因他這一線得手，湘州才暴露在隋軍面前。湘州刺史薛胄是第二批入湘的隋將，與行軍總管劉仁恩配合作戰，先掃清城外出迎之敵，再乘勝入城，俘陳叔慎。別將龐暉是此役的悲劇人物，他輕信陳叔慎的詐降，只率數百人入城，遭設伏被殺，隋軍第一次入湘即告挫敗，迫使主帥改用重兵進攻。陳方主將陳叔慎是陳室宗親、封岳陽王，出鎮湘州多年，手下有兵有地，詐降設伏是他的手筆，徵兵五千、據城拒守也出自他的決斷；出城迎戰的湘州助防將軍陳正理與衡陽郡太守樊通一同出師而潰，與陳叔慎同為敗局關鍵。陳後主陳叔寶坐鎮建康，湘州既失，江南再無屏障。
peopleEn: Six men decided the course of this battle. Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the supreme strategist: in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang he mustered a great army to attack Chen by several routes, with the object of destroying the southern dynasty and ending the division of north and south. Yang Su, the Chief Military Commander, led the river fleet in the upper Yangtze, came down the river and cleared away Chen's river defences; only because that line succeeded did Xiangzhou lie open before the Sui army. Xue Zhou, Inspector of Xiangzhou, was the second Sui commander to enter the prefecture; acting together with Liu Ren'en, Commander of the Marching Army, he first swept away the enemy that came out of the city to meet him and then entered the walls on the strength of that victory, taking Chen Shushen prisoner. Pang Hui, the advance commander, was the tragic figure of the operation: he believed the feigned surrender sent by Chen Shushen, went into the city with only several hundred men, and was killed in an ambush, so that the Sui army's first entry into Xiangzhou ended in a rout and the commanders had to change to an assault with main force. The Chen commander, Chen Shushen, was a kinsman of the Chen imperial house, enfeoffed as Prince of Yueyang, and had governed Xiangzhou for years with troops and territory of his own; the feigned surrender and the ambush were his doing, and both the levy of five thousand men and the decision to hold the city came from him as well. Chen Zhengli, the Assistant Defence General of Xiangzhou, and Fan Tong, the Governor of Hengyang, marched out of the city to meet the Sui and were routed, and they too were keys to the collapse. Chen Shubao, the Chen ruler, sat at Jiankang; once Xiangzhou was lost, the south of the river had no further screen.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵屬於古希臘的方陣步兵：頭盔、護胸、護腿，配上結實的圓盾與長矛，成排互相遮蔽站成方陣，是前五世紀至前四世紀希臘城邦步兵的標準配備。它與開皇九年的湘州之戰相隔一千一百年以上，戰場上不可能出現任何一名這樣裝備的戰士，所以在本役的裝備體系裡它只是一個對照物：它代表的是以人體與盾牆承擔防禦、正面硬撞的兵種，而湘州會戰裡的雙方走的完全是另一條路。隋軍在江南水網地形的裝備以弩弓為火力骨幹，步卒披札甲、執長刀與槊，盾手用牌或小盾成列蔽弩；騎兵是隋軍在平曠地上的主要衝擊力量；水軍有楊素在長江上游所造的五牙大艦與黃龍艦，艦上設拍竿以擲石、焚燒敵船，並備蒙輪、撞車一類防護與攻城器械。隋軍在江南攻城時的常規做法是先用弩陣與攻城器械壓制城頭，再令步卒登城；湘州城破的過程記載簡略，細節已不可考。陳方的州兵以鄉兵為主，多持大盾、刀、槊與弓箭，輔以城頭的擂木、弩與火。沒有希臘式的方陣，也沒有密集重裝步兵的正面對撞，湘州的勝負靠的是弩、騎兵、舟師與城防器械的配合。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card belongs to the phalanx infantry of archaic Greece: helmet, cuirass and greaves, a solid round shield and a long spear, drawn up in ranks that cover one another, was the standard kit of the citizen infantry of the Greek city-states in the fifth and fourth centuries BC. It stands more than eleven hundred years away from the battle of Xiangzhou in 589, and not a single man equipped in that manner could have been on the field, so within the equipment system of this campaign it can only serve as a foil: it stands for the kind of soldier who takes the burden of defence on his own body and a wall of shields and meets the enemy head-on in a collision, whereas both sides at Xiangzhou went down a quite different road. The Sui equipment in a landscape of southern waterways rested on the bow and crossbow as the framework of its firepower; infantry wore lamellar armour and carried long sabres and spears, while shield-bearers used large shields or small shields drawn up in ranks to cover the crossbowmen; cavalry was the Sui main shock force on open ground; and the river arm included the five-tooth great ships and the yellow dragon ships built by Yang Su in the upper Yangtze, fitted with pole-mounted projectors to throw stones and fire at enemy craft, together with wheeled armoured screens and battering rams of the kind used for protection and for siege work. The normal Sui practice when storming a town in the south was to cover the walls first with massed crossbow fire and siege engines and then send infantry up; the account of how the walls of Xiangzhou were broken is brief and the details are no longer recoverable. The Chen prefectural militia was made up mostly of local levies carrying large shields, sabres, spears and bows, assisted by wooden beams, crossbows and fire from the walls. There was no Greek-style phalanx and no head-on collision of massed heavy infantry: the outcome at Xiangzhou was settled by the combination of crossbows, cavalry, river craft and fortification equipment.
tactics: 湘州戰役的戰術主軸是先取上游、再穩江南、最後趨嶺南的縱深推進。上游方面，楊素統水軍沿長江東下，陳軍在長江中游的抵抗被清除，隋軍得以把湘州當作南岸的落腳點，而不是孤軍深入。第一步是試探：別將龐暉率數百人直趨湘州，陳叔慎不與硬拼，派人詐降並在城中設伏，龐暉中伏被斬，隋軍第一次進攻即告全軍覆沒；這次教訓使主帥改為主力進攻。第二步是薛胄、劉仁恩率大軍直抵城下，先在城外野戰中擊敗湘州助防將軍陳正理與衡陽郡太守樊通率領的出城迎戰之軍，趁其新敗、援兵未至，進逼城垣攻入城中，俘陳叔慎。第三步是分兵追擊，劉仁恩部在常德橫橋追上武州刺史邬居業的部眾，一戰擒之，掃清湘州以西、以南的殘部。陳方的戰術則是守禦與反擊並行：據城待援、就地徵兵、出城迎戰，並以詐降打擊敵軍指揮官，試圖以拖延換取建康方面的時間。全戰役沒有一次決定性會戰，靠的是總體態勢與各線銜接取勝。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the Xiangzhou campaign was a deep advance in a fixed order: take the upper river first, steady the south of the river next, and then move down towards Lingnan. In the upper reaches Yang Su led the river fleet down the Yangtze and Chen's resistance in the middle reaches was swept away, which allowed the Sui to use Xiangzhou as a foothold on the southern bank instead of pushing a single expedition deep inland. The first step was a probe: the advance commander Pang Hui took several hundred men straight at Xiangzhou; Chen Shushen did not stand and fight but sent men with a feigned surrender and set an ambush inside the city; Pang Hui walked into it and was cut down, and the Sui's first attack ended with the whole detachment lost, a lesson that forced the commanders to switch to an assault with main force. The second step was for Xue Zhou and Liu Ren'en to bring the main army straight to the walls: they first defeated in the field outside the town the force that came out to meet them under the Assistant Defence General of Xiangzhou, Chen Zhengli, and the Governor of Hengyang, Fan Tong; and while that enemy was still reeling and no relief had arrived, they closed on the walls, entered the city and took Chen Shushen prisoner. The third step was the pursuit: Liu Ren'en's troops caught up with the followers of the Inspector of Wuzhou, Wu Juye, at Hengqiao near Changde, took him prisoner in a single action, and swept away the remnants west and south of Xiangzhou. On the Chen side, defence and counter-attack were run together: hold the town and wait for relief, levy men on the spot, fight out of the gates, and use the feigned surrender to strike at the enemy's commanders, in the hope of buying time for the capital at Jiankang. There was no single decisive engagement in the whole campaign; it was won by the general situation and by the way the separate lines of effort were joined.
data: 可據的數字有限，但幾個關鍵點是明確的。時間上，湘州之戰在開皇九年（589年）二月，緊接在同年正月隋軍攻入建康、陳後主出降、陳朝覆亡之後，湘州是陳朝崩解後最遲被解決的抵抗點之一。陳方兵員，陳叔慎徵兵五千，出城迎戰的是陳正理與樊通所部。隋方這一次入湘的兵力，資治通鑑沒有留下數目，只記龐暉所率為數百人，且全軍覆沒於城中設伏；其後薛胄、劉仁恩所率主力顯然遠多於此，否則不足以壓制五千州兵、攻入州城，還要分兵追擊邬居業。地理上，湘州治所在長沙，橫橋在今常德市，兩地相距約二百里，長江與湘水的水路聯繫是隋軍運糧與陳軍轉移的共同依賴。上游水軍方面，楊素所造五牙大艦每艦置戰士百人，艦上設拍竿，陳人望之如山，黃龍艦等大船隨行列陣；隋朝在開皇八年冬集結的伐陳大軍，傳世史籍有數十萬之說，其中絕大部分是沿途徵發的丁壯與輸運人員。戰果方面，湘州城破、陳叔慎被俘、邬居業於橫橋被擒，陳在湘州、衡陽、武州一帶的旗籍隨之瓦解。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are few, but several key points are firm. In time, the battle of Xiangzhou falls in the second month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, 589, immediately after the Sui army entered Jiankang in the first month of the same year and the Chen ruler surrendered, so that Xiangzhou was one of the last points of Chen resistance to be settled after the dynasty had already collapsed. On the Chen side the numbers are these: Chen Shushen levied five thousand men, and the force that marched out of the city to meet the Sui was the contingent of Chen Zhengli and Fan Tong. The Sui strength on this first entry is not given a figure in the Zizhi Tongjian, which records only that Pang Hui took several hundred men and that the whole detachment was destroyed in the ambush inside the city; the main force under Xue Zhou and Liu Ren'en that followed must clearly have been much larger, or it could not have beaten five thousand prefectural militia, entered the prefectural seat, and still detached troops to pursue Wu Juye. In geography, the seat of Xiangzhou was at Changsha and Hengqiao lies in what is now the city of Changde, roughly two hundred li apart, and the water link between the Yangtze and the Xiang River was the common dependence of the Sui supply train and of Chen movement. On the river side in the upper reaches, the five-tooth great ships built by Yang Su carried a hundred fighting men each, with pole-mounted projectors on deck, and the Chen men saw them like a mountain moving; great ships such as the yellow dragon vessels drew up in line with them. The Sui armies mustered for the attack on Chen in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang are put in the transmitted histories at several hundred thousand, and the great majority of that number was levies picked up along the route and men employed in transport. As for results: the city of Xiangzhou was taken, Chen Shushen was taken prisoner, Wu Juye was captured at Hengqiao, and the Chen administrative network in the area of Xiangzhou, Hengyang and Wuzhou broke up with them.
cause: 湘州會戰的直接起因，是隋朝滅陳的戰略在長江中游得手。開皇八年冬，隋文帝以舉國之力分道伐陳，楊素統上游水軍沿江東下，陳朝在荊州、岳州一線的江防與援軍被牽制，長江中游的天險已不再能阻擋隋軍。湘州是陳朝控制長江以南、嶺北的關鍵州，治長沙，握湘水漕運，東連建康、西通黔中，一旦落入隋手，隋軍便等於在陳朝腹地插上一支前鋒，既可策應下游渡江大軍，又能沿湘水與粵水直取廣州。所以陳叔慎寧可拒絕歸降，也要以詐降先殺隋軍前鋒、拖慢對方腳步。但起因的根子仍在陳朝本身：陳後主昏闇，州郡守將各自擁兵，朝廷猜忌宗室諸王，把有兵有地、能獨當一面的陳叔慎外放湘州，正想讓他與江南形勢隔絕；陳叔慎既握重兵，便不甘束手，一旦隋軍溯江而上，湘州守軍的抵抗，其實也是陳室內部裂痕的最後一次顯露。隋滅陳的大戰略與陳朝內部的空虛，在湘州撞在了一起。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting at Xiangzhou was the success of the Sui strategy for the destruction of Chen in the middle reaches of the Yangtze. In the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang Emperor Wen of Sui put the whole strength of the realm into an attack on Chen by several routes; Yang Su led the river fleet in the upper reaches down the Yangtze, the river defences and the relief armies of Chen along the Jingzhou and Yuezhou line were tied down, and the natural barrier of the middle Yangtze could no longer hold the Sui back. Xiangzhou was the key prefecture by which the Chen dynasty held the south of the Yangtze and the northern Ling region: seated at Changsha, it commanded the water transport of the Xiang River, reaching east to Jiankang and west to Qianzhong, and once it fell into Sui hands the Sui army would have planted an advance guard in the belly of the Chen state, able both to support the great armies crossing the river downstream and to move straight down the Xiang and the Yue rivers towards Guangzhou. That is why Chen Shushen preferred refusal to surrender and chose to strike at the Sui vanguard with a feigned surrender, hoping to slow the enemy down. But the root of the affair lay in the Chen dynasty itself: the Chen ruler was dissolute, the governors of the prefectures held troops of their own, and the court distrusted the princes of the imperial house, so that Chen Shushen, a man with troops and territory who could stand on his own, was posted away to Xiangzhou in the hope of cutting him off from the situation in the south; having troops in his hand, Chen Shushen was in no mind to submit, and once the Sui came up the river the resistance of the Xiangzhou garrison was in fact the last showing of the cracks inside the Chen house. The great Sui strategy for the destruction of Chen and the emptiness within the Chen state collided at Xiangzhou.
impact: 湘州平定的意義，超出一次州郡的攻佔。第一，隋朝在南岸取得了真正的立足點。此前隋軍渡江靠的是賀若弼、韓擒虎兩部在采石、姑孰一帶強行突破，兵不能久據於江中；湘州既下，長江中游有了一個可以屯兵、屯糧、修造舟師的基地，隋軍自此在江南作戰不必再靠一次次的奇襲渡江。第二，嶺北與嶺南的通道被打開。湘州失守後，陳朝在嶺北的各州郡相繼望風而降，隋廷隨後遣使招撫嶺南，冼夫人率其部眾迎接隋使、協助平定陳朝殘部，廣州一帶的抵抗在數月之內平息，南北重新統一的最後一段路由此走通。第三，行政層面上，隋朝在平陳之後重整江南州郡，湘州改置為潭州，治長沙，長沙自此成為湖南的政治與軍事中心，這一格局一直延續到唐宋。第四，制度上，陳氏一朝的州兵、宗族部曲與世族武力隨之解體，隋朝在江南推行的租庸調與府兵整編得以往內陸各地推開，湘州是這場整編最早落實的州府之一。
impactEn: The taking of Xiangzhou meant more than the capture of one prefecture. First, the Sui gained a real foothold on the southern bank. Until then their crossing of the river had rested on the two columns of He Ruobi and Han Qinhu forcing a crossing at the Caishi and Gushu stretch, and troops could not be held long on the river; with Xiangzhou in hand there was a place in the middle Yangtze where troops could be quartered, where grain could be stored and where river craft could be built and repaired, and the Sui no longer had to rely on one surprise crossing after another to fight in the south. Second, the corridor between the northern Ling region and Lingnan was opened. After the loss of Xiangzhou the Chen prefectures in the north came over one after another, the Sui court then sent envoys to bring Lingnan over, the Lady Xian led her followers to meet the Sui envoys and helped to put down the remaining Chen forces, and resistance around Guangzhou ended within a few months, so that the last stretch of the road to a reunited north and south was carried. Third, at the administrative level, the Sui reorganised the prefectures of the south after the fall of Chen, Xiangzhou was re-set as Tanzhou with its seat at Changsha, and Changsha from that point on became the political and military centre of Hunan, a pattern that ran on into the Tang and Song. Fourth, in institutional terms the prefectural militia, the clan contingents and the armed strength of the great families of the Chen house fell apart with the dynasty, and the rent, labour and service system and the reorganisation of the fubing that the Sui pushed in the south were able to advance into the interior regions, and Xiangzhou was among the first prefectures where that reorganisation actually took root.
result: 就開皇九年二月這一場而言，結果是隋軍全勝。別將龐暉的失敗沒有改變戰局：陳叔慎詐降設伏，斬龐暉及所部數百人，贏了一場遭遇戰；但薛胄、劉仁恩率主力隨即進攻，在城外野戰中擊潰湘州助防將軍陳正理與衡陽郡太守樊通之軍，趁勢攻入城中，陳叔慎被俘，湘州平定；劉仁恩部再於常德橫橋追上武州刺史邬居業，擊其軍而擒之，湘州、衡陽、武州一帶的陳軍抵抗至此全部瓦解。這場戰役沒有大戰，因為陳朝的主幹已在正月隨建康陷落而折斷，湘州只是斷樹上最後一片葉子；但它決定了陳朝在江南的殘餘勢力向哪裡倒：向隋。湘州既下，隋軍得以據湘水、粵水通道南下嶺南，廣州方向的陳朝舊將與地方豪強在隋使招撫與軍事壓力雙管齊下之下相率歸附，陳朝覆亡、南北統一成為不可逆的結局。而就這件卡面兵器而言，希臘重步兵沒有出現在這場戰役的任何一頁，真正守在湘州城頭與城下的，是持牌執槊的陳朝州兵與披甲持弩的隋軍步卒。
resultEn: For the fighting of the second month of 589 the result was a complete Sui victory. The failure of the advance commander Pang Hui did not change the course of events: Chen Shushen had used a feigned surrender and an ambush to cut down Pang Hui and the several hundred men with him, winning an engagement in the field; but Xue Zhou and Liu Ren'en at once advanced with the main force, routed in the field outside the town the troops of the Assistant Defence General of Xiangzhou, Chen Zhengli, and of the Governor of Hengyang, Fan Tong, and on the strength of that entered the city and took Chen Shushen prisoner, so that Xiangzhou was settled; Liu Ren'en's troops then overtook the Inspector of Wuzhou, Wu Juye, at Hengqiao near Changde, beat his men and took him, and the Chen resistance in the area of Xiangzhou, Hengyang and Wuzhou came apart completely. There was no great battle in this campaign, because the main trunk of the Chen state had already been broken when Jiankang fell in the first month; Xiangzhou was only the last leaf on the fallen tree. Yet it decided which way the surviving forces of the Chen in the south would fall: towards the Sui. With Xiangzhou taken, the Sui could move down towards Lingnan along the Xiang and Yue water routes, and the old Chen generals and local strongmen around Guangzhou came over one after another under the double pressure of Sui envoys and Sui troops, so that the fall of Chen and the reunification of north and south became an irreversible conclusion. As for the weapon on the card, the hoplite appears on no page of this campaign at all: what really held the walls and the gates of Xiangzhou were the Chen prefectural soldiers with their large shields and spears, and the Sui infantry in armour with their crossbows.
